recommendation: Keep this commit as-is; it completes the already-applied FHIR-37416 cleanup in current core source without reopening broader messaging semantics or binding-policy issues.
issue_request: FHIR-37416 was a Published/Persuasive FHIR-core technical correction asking that the section 3.4.6 messaging operation examples stop using DSTU2-era MessageHeader.data and MessageHeader.event forms and align with current MessageHeader.focus and MessageHeader.event[x].
initial_application: The original application commit 307c3216b45f4fc4ba59d6026605cad823d47daf changed the operation-message examples in source/messaging.html from MessageHeader.data to MessageHeader.focus and from <event> to <eventCoding>, but left adjacent prose referring to MessageHeader.event, event.system, event.code, and a misspelled MesssageHeader.focus.
additional_context: source/messaging.html is linked from the active core documentation page, and source/fhir.ini lists MessageHeader as an active resource. The current MessageHeader StructureDefinition defines MessageHeader.event[x] with Coding/uri/canonical choices and MessageHeader.focus as the actual message content. Zulip and Confluence searches found no directly relevant contrary decision; later generic eventCoding discussions concerned binding policy, not this example cleanup.
reconciliation: Changed source/messaging.html to name MessageHeader.event[x] in the bundle rule, MessageHeader.eventCoding.system and MessageHeader.eventCoding.code in the operation invocation bullets, and correctly spelled/code-formatted MessageHeader.focus in the single-return bullet.
source_changes: source/messaging.html: replaced stale MessageHeader.event prose with MessageHeader.event[x] in the message bundle rule.
source/messaging.html: replaced event.system/event.code operation guidance with MessageHeader.eventCoding.system and MessageHeader.eventCoding.code.
source/messaging.html: corrected the single-return guidance to refer to MessageHeader.focus.
